ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: MitiMiti uses the microphone only while you hold the dictate button, to type the expense for you.
ios.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: MitiMiti turns what you dictate into text to log the expense. Your phone does the recognition.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: MitiMiti uses the camera to photograph a receipt and read the total. The photo is not kept.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: MitiMiti opens your photos so you can pick a receipt and read the total. The photo is not kept.
